verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents connecting HubSpot, Salesforce and Stripe so Ari plans from those records, forecasting revenue from business drivers, and importing actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet into a model Ari keeps current and flags when numbers move. That covers the core of building a CRM- or subscription-driven revenue plan and comparing it to actuals. missing for 10: explicit documentation of pipeline-to-revenue-plan mechanics (e.g., stage weighting, MRR/churn modeling), a documented plan-vs-actual variance view, independent or hands-on corroboration.
